about: Pre-registered before any real-data result was seen. The git history of this file is the registration date. Edit the thresholds BEFORE running scripts/consensus_check.py on real data or before the journal has rows; the report flags any change made after the first journal row.

backtest.description: On the nine original sector SPDRs from 2010-01-01, the consensus with equal weighting must beat SPY buy-and-hold on after-tax CAGR (everything sold at the end), and beat it on compound growth in at least 95% of block-bootstrap resamples.

forward.description: In the forward journal, on days with a Buy or Strong buy call, those symbols must beat SPY over the next 21 sessions: at least 60 independent days, a positive mean excess return and a t-statistic of at least 2.

paper.description: Paper fills must cost no more than double the assumed slippage on average, over at least 50 fills, for the backtests' cost assumption to stand.
